checkpoints.name: Data foundations: the IndexedDB store with a versioned schema and migration runner, the household, member and expense model, the quick-split rules with exactness tests, derived shares, repositories

Households and members: routes, the household switcher and list (create, rename, archive), members (add, rename, mark as left, rejoin), the Tabs and Dialog kit components, the empty and unavailable states
Quick expenses: add, view, edit and delete, split equally, by shares, by exact amounts or by percentages, any member as payer, and the household overview
Itemised expenses: save a split to a household, split a bill from a household, edit an itemised expense in the split, the duplicate-receipt warning
History: every expense newest first by month, filters by member and category, accent-insensitive search
Quality pass and documentation: the completion scenario and migration tests, screens and design checkers, privacy checks, ADR 0005, DESIGN.md, READMEs, roadmap, the design canvas
